Name: Fluffy Cows
Author: Maromidew
Description:
A reskin that turns the cows and calfs into fluffy cows! 
The files are named to be used with the white cows in game, but if you'd like to use it for brown cows change the file names to Brown Cow and BabyBrown Cow. 

 I hope you guys enjoy. If you have any recolour requests please comment them, ideas for other mods are welcome too.

Downloads.Description: Contains both cow and calf files.
